name: The Roots
hook: A hip-hop group with a live band, whose drummer learned to play the way J Dilla programmed.
blurb: Ahmir 'Questlove' Thompson and Tariq 'Black Thought' Trotter met at the Philadelphia High School for Creative and Performing Arts and started The Roots in 1987. Most rap groups built their music from samples. The Roots played theirs on real instruments, with Questlove on drums, which turns the sampling story upside down: instead of producers lifting drummers off records, a drummer learned to copy a producer's programmed feel by hand. Questlove has described hearing J Dilla's beats as the turning point in his playing, and he started playing slightly off the beat on purpose, the way Dilla's machine did. The late-1990s records made by the circle called the Soulquarians (The Roots, D'Angelo, Common and Erykah Badu, with Dilla and Questlove at the centre) are where that feel moved from programmed beats into live playing. Since 2009 The Roots have been the house band on Jimmy Fallon's television shows.

signatureTracks.title: What They Do
signatureTracks.whyThisOne: From Illadelph Halflife, their clearest early statement of live-band hip-hop.

signatureTracks.title: You Got Me
signatureTracks.whyThisOne: From Things Fall Apart, with Erykah Badu and Eve. Their biggest hit.
